title: Ordinal Distributional Change and Conservative Transition Benchmarks: Measurement, Identification, and Inference
abstract: arXiv:2604.12611v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Repeated cross-sections reveal changes in ordinal distributions but not the transitions that produce those changes. This paper identifies which transitions are unavoidable under least-displacement reconciliation of observed marginals. I develop a probability metric for ordinal change based on threshold geometry and aggregation, and show that its optimal-transport form measures the minimal average number of thresholds crossed, yielding conservative benchmark transition plans. For missing outcomes, I derive sharp identified sets for both the discrepancy and benchmark plans. Projection-based empirical likelihood, with Monte Carlo and Wilks calibration, ensures valid finite-sample and asymptotic inferences, respectively. Applied to Arab Barometer data, the method uncovers a robust shift toward regular remittance receipt in Lebanon and highlights the transition from nonreceipt to recurrent support as a necessary feature of benchmark recon

translated_title: 序数分布变化与保守过渡基准：度量、识别与推断
translated_abstract: 重复截面数据揭示了序数分布的变化，但无法揭示产生这些变化的转移过程。本文在最小位移协调观测边际的条件下，识别出哪些转移是不可避免的。我基于阈值几何与聚合开发了一种用于序数变化的概率度量，并证明其最优传输形式度量了平均跨越阈值的最小数量，从而产生保守的基准转移计划。对于缺失结果，我推导了差异和基准计划的尖锐识别集。基于投影的经验似然方法，结合蒙特卡洛和Wilks校准，分别确保有限样本和渐近推断的有效性。应用于阿拉伯晴雨表数据时，该方法揭示了黎巴嫩向定期汇款接收的稳健转变，并强调了从非接收到经常性支持的转移作为基准重构的必要特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最优传输的序数分布变化度量方法，用于识别不可避免的转移并构建保守基准，并通过经验似然推断在缺失数据下实现有效估计，应用于阿拉伯晴雨表数据揭示了黎巴嫩汇款接收的稳健转变。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimal-transport-based metric for ordinal distributional change to identify unavoidable transitions and construct conservative benchmarks, with empirical likelihood inference ensuring validity under missing data, applied to Arab Barometer data revealing a robust shift toward remittance receipt in Lebanon.
